title: List of Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. episodes
content:
Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. is an American television series created for ABC by Joss Whedon, Jed Whedon, and Maurissa Tancharoen, based on the Marvel Comics organization S.H.I.E.L.D. It is set in the Marvel Cinematic Universe (MCU) and acknowledges the continuity of the franchise's films and other television series. The series was produced by ABC Studios, Marvel Television, and Mutant Enemy Productions, and sees Clark Gregg reprise his role as Phil Coulson from the film series. During the course of the series, 136 episodes of Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. aired over seven seasons, between September 24, 2013, and August 12, 2020.
